Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 1st-level spells

Benefit: As long as you have an enhancing spell of 1st level or higher in your known spells and have at least 1 MP in your MP pool, you can use a standard action to provide a circumstance bonus to AC equal to the level of the highest-level enhancing spell you can cast, to yourself or an ally within 30 feet. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting enhancing spells.
